_what: How a person's writing voice is kept (src/voice.mjs). Two record types: an edit (what the person changed in words an AI wrote: before and after, kept the moment they change a draft) and a profile (what an AI has learned about how this person writes, as the named fields below). Everything that varies is a row here: the types, the sizes, the profile's fields, the words an AI is told. A field is added or removed by editing `profile_fields`; nothing in code names one.

profile_fields.label: How they write
profile_fields.description: In their own terms: length, warmth, directness, how they open and close.

profile_fields.label: Words and phrases they use
profile_fields.description: Words, phrases and spellings they reach for or put in when they change a draft.

profile_fields.label: Words and phrases they take out
profile_fields.description: What they delete or replace when they edit a draft.

profile_fields.label: Their own lines to copy
profile_fields.description: Short lines from what they wrote or sent that sound most like them.

words.how_to_use: Write the way this person writes. Read profiles first, then the edits: each edit is an AI's draft (before) beside the words the person changed it to (after). After drafting, if their edits show something the profile lacks, save it with save_voice. Sent shows words they published.
words.no_profile: No profile is saved yet. Learn from the edits and sent words below, then save one with save_voice.
words.stale: This profile was saved again at {set_at}, not at {expected}, since you read it. Read it again with read_voice and edit from what it shows now.
words.unknown_field: {field} is not a field of a voice profile. The fields are: {fields}.
words.too_many_profiles: An account keeps at most {max} voice profiles, one for each kind of writing. Save into one that exists, or forget one first.
words.bad_kind: kind is a short lower-case name for what is written (like post or email), at most 40 letters, digits and dashes.
words.nothing_named: Name what to forget: profile_id, edit_id, or all_edits true.
